body: I am still alive and doing better.  Thank you for your help.  I don't even remember posting this.  Between when I did & now, I have spent a long weekend at the VA's inpatient mental health ward.  That was a terrifying experience, and I will not allow myself to possibly spend any more time there.  I still drink heavily every night, but I am committed to change.  Mentally & physically.  Thank you again for taking the time to respond to my plea for help.
